sources.carry: motion build, review standards, audits, the craft canon, the variant picker

rulings.positions: jakubkrehel: exactly `0.96` vs emilkowalski: `0.95–0.98` range.
rulings.ruling: 0.96 exact. An exact value is enforceable; a range invites drift. Emil's range noted as tolerance.

rulings.positions: jakubkrehel: always `0` vs emilkowalski: subtle `0.1–0.3` when used.
rulings.ruling: bounce 0 by default; nonzero only when the design direction's register explicitly calls for playful.

rulings.positions: emil monolith: gentler-not-zero, keep opacity/color vs animationsdev refs: disable all, no exceptions.
rulings.ruling: gentler-not-zero. Matches the two-variant doctrine; blanket disable is the lazier reading.

rulings.positions: jakubkrehel + emil monolith: ease-out both directions vs emil design-rules: accelerate away (ease-in).
rulings.ruling: ease-out for exits by default. Two of three sources, including Emil against himself. Accelerate-away allowed as a deliberate, stated choice.

rulings.positions: animationsdev: apply proactively vs jakubkrehel: only on observed first-frame stutter vs ibelick baseline: never outside an active animation.
rulings.ruling: reactive (jakub) — evidence-driven application only. Baseline's phrasing survives as the generation guardrail.

rulings.positions: emilkowalski: "built-ins are too weak" vs ibelick baseline: "never introduce custom curves."
rulings.ruling: split by intent. Custom curves from the kit's named set: yes. Inventing novel curves ad hoc: no.

rulings.positions: emilkowalski: 30–80ms per item vs jakubkrehel: ~100ms per group.
rulings.ruling: both — the units differ (list items vs semantic chunks). Reconciled in one paragraph; not a conflict.

rulings.positions: ibelick: explain why disabled vs jakubkrehel: never disable; validate on submit.
rulings.ruling: never disable. Wins on accessibility evidence — an enabled button that validates is discoverable; a disabled one is a dead end.

rulings.positions: vercel web-interface-guidelines: Title Case headings, "&" over "and", autocomplete stated both ways vs jakubkrehel: "evidence, not taste."
rulings.ruling: the evidence bar. House-taste rows are cut from the vendored copy (via its patch); the autocomplete tension resolves to: autocomplete on purposeful fields, off only for non-auth-sensitive cases.
